sections.abstract: EXAMPLE ONLY. Paraphrase the verified author abstract in your own words. Identify the problem, method and conclusion, and link the exact source. Do not invent a study to fill this template.
sections.problem: Describe the research question, setting, available inputs, required outputs and the important constraints.
sections.mechanism: Explain the method in ordered causal steps. Include an equation only when it helps, defining every symbol and identifying the original equation or your structural summary.
sections.novelty: Separate inherited components from the new contribution and compare with a verified direct predecessor.
sections.evidence:
| Conditions and baseline | Result | Source and boundary |
|---|---|---|
| Replace with verified conditions | Include metric and denominator | Cite section, page, table or theorem; state limits |
sections.limitations: Connect specific assumptions to consequences. Distinguish an observed failure, a missing experiment and information that has not been checked.
sections.relevance: Independent analysis: explain which part of the configured research question this could inform, and what must hold for transfer.
sections.microexperiment: Proposed next step, not a reported result: specify a hypothesis, data or platform, fair-budget comparison, metric and a result that would falsify the hypothesis. For nonexperimental fields propose an appropriate verifiable follow-up.
sections.reading: Name the first sections to read and the questions each answers. Verify that any code/data link belongs to this exact paper. Record read-only inspection separately from running a reproduction.
